content.what_it_is: Under the COUPLING preprocessor guard, COUPLING_INITIAL opens a one-way nesting file, reads boundary counts/start indices, the first time level of U/V/elevation on four sides, and maps each global boundary segment into a local serial or MPI boundary span (L45-L344). OneWayCoupling advances two time slots from the still-open unit 11, computes interpolation weights, writes interpolated ETA/U/V into ghost cells on physical boundary ranks, and reconstructs HU/HV (L348-L597).
entities: COUPLING_INITIAL uses GLOBAL and INPUT_READ host data without local declarations @L54-L56
global coupling fields N_COUPLING_{EAST,WEST,SOUTH,NORTH}, J_START_{EAST,WEST}, I_START_{SOUTH,NORTH}, TIME_COUPLING_1, TIME_COUPLING_2 read/assigned @L79-L95
global local-span fields Kstart/Kend/Kshift and IN_DOMAIN for WEST @L179-L200, EAST @L222-L245, SOUTH @L265-L288, NORTH @L308-L331

unresolved: The initial reader consumes each side label/separator with a list-directed READ having no item (east L102; analogous west/south/north L121, L138, L155). The update routine's replacements instead read every separator into TIME_COUPLING_2 (east L376, west L401, south L428, north L455, plus absent-side branches L395, L422, L449, L476). This overwrites the actual time read at L371 with non-time side records or advances the numeric time incorrectly, a repeated copy/port mismatch that corrupts schedule parsing.

Both the initial equal-time state and EOF collapse interpolation weights to zero: TIME_COUPLING_2 is initialized equal to TIME_COUPLING_1 (L93-L95), while equal slots set tmp1=tmp2=ZERO (L488-L497). At EOF, TIME_COUPLING_1 is first advanced to TIME_COUPLING_2, the failed read jumps to L483 (L367-L372), and the same equal-slot branch zeros every coupled ETA/U/V ghost value at L509-L588 instead of retaining the last boundary record.
